verdict.rationale: Runpod is GPU and serverless compute infrastructure, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is outside its product role. The evidence covers only MCP servers Runpod publishes so other agents can manage Runpod. That is the server role and cannot be credited toward this client-side story. Nothing in the evidence shows Runpod's own products acting as an MCP client.
